properties.description: The first step of the cross-design layer. registry_http.rs: RegistryHandle { inner: Weak<Inner> } (Weak, because a strong handle cycles Inner→open→Slot→OpenDesign.http→closure→svc→Inner), GraphRouter::handle(), RegistryHandle::other_design_export(graph_id) -> Result<GraphExport, Refusal> built on service_for (the InFlight guard held for the call, a slot taken like any request, the same Busy and eviction), store.upgrade(), read().await → export_graph(), the guard dropped inside the block; open_design ends .with_caller_rule(..).with_registry(self.handle()). service.rs: registry: Option<RegistryHandle> (None in wrap_at, cloned in share()), READABLE_GRAPH_IDS_META = "reflow2/readable_graph_ids" beside WRITES_FOR_META, read per call into a task-local like WRITES_FOR, and the one resolver ReflowService::other_design(graph_id), which refuses in order: no registry ("served only by a registry server — pass a path here"); the design's own graph_id; a caller rule that is neither TrustedGateway nor BearerToken; no _meta set on the call ("the host names that set on every call, reads included"); an id not in the set ("not in the set of designs the host handed over on this call. Whether a design by that id is here, and what it holds, is not said"). The tools export the other design first and then take their own read guard — never two guards at once. compare_designs: base_path optional, + other_graph_id; alone it compares the live graph (labelled by its graph_id) against the other (labelled by its id); other_graph_id with a path is refused; neither is "nothing to compare". compose_and_analyse: design optional, + other_graph_id, exactly one of the two; namespace defaults to the graph_id. THE HOLE CLOSED: reflow2 had no hosted-mode refusal for any path-taking tool (without_tree affects only measure), so a registry server behind a trusted gateway read a host path and answered a diff — measured live in the failing-first run; compare_designs with a path is now refused when served_from_registry() ("a path is not served here; name the design by graph_id"). certify_preservation, merge_designs, apply_merge, fork_point and alternatives still read paths on a registry server and stay on the gateway's refused list until widened (AGENTS.md names them). Toolsnaps for the two tools re-blessed (new optional fields, types widened to nullable; 197 match); the surface-only-grows test passes. Built 2026-10-11 (5a282ebb9): failing-first 5 of 5 wire tests failed on the unchanged binary, 6 of 6 pass with the change including A→B / B→A concurrently; full workspace 3,226 passed. NOT YET: the flo2 gateway must send _meta reflow2/readable_graph_ids on every call including reads (today only on writes), take compare_designs out of REFUSED_TOOLS with base_path/other_path as REFUSED_ARGUMENTS, and check membership of other_graph_id; and the open cost of the second design on flo2.io's registry is unmeasured — the requirement's "measure before widening the family" step. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.name: compare_designs and compose_and_analyse take the other design by graph_id on a registry server, through one resolver bounded by the readable set the trusted host hands over in _meta; a path is refused on a registry server
